summary: The diff addresses all three requirements. Backend authorization logic was modified (REQ-1), authentication state integration was implemented (REQ-2), and frontend components were updated to support authenticated operations (REQ-3). All evidence shows proper authorization checks using AccessControl.hasPermission and integration with the passcode-based auth system.

hallucinated_features.description: User Profile System with methods getCallerUserProfile, getUserProfile, and saveCallerUserProfile
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest focuses exclusively on fixing admin dashboard permissions for Nakshatra edits and images. No user profile functionality was requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Public read access for Nakshatras (readNakshatra, getAllNakshatras, getNakshatraByNumber, searchNakshatras)
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest only addresses admin write operations (save edits, replace images). Changes to public read access were not requested and fall outside the scope of fixing admin permissions.

hallucinated_features.description: AdminLogoutButton component with Internet Identity clear functionality
hallucinated_features.reason: While logout functionality is reasonable for admin features, the BuildRequest specifically states as a non-goal: 'Changing the authentication mechanism from passcode to Internet Identity'. The logout button explicitly clears Internet Identity state.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity integration in usePasscodeAuth hook
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly lists as a constraint: 'Maintain the existing passcode-based authentication system' and as a non-goal: 'Changing the authentication mechanism from passcode to Internet Identity'. The implementation adds II login flow which contradicts these constraints.
